name: n2-quarterly-liquidity-brief-environment
description: Treasury reporting runtime for cash position analysis.

tools.pull_cash_positions: Collects current cash balances and records cash_positions_pulled.
tools.calculate_runway: Requires pulled cash positions, calculates runway, records runway_calculated, and returns runway_days from 95 through 130.
tools.publish_treasury_brief: Requires a calculated runway and records treasury_brief_published.
